text: The market sits at the centre, on the main road.
Residential wards sit around the centre.
Noisy and smelly trades (tanners, smiths) sit downstream or at the edge, away from patricians.
Patricians live on high ground, near the castle.
source: Emilien et al., Procedural Generation of Villages on Arbitrary Terrains, The Visual Computer 28 (2012)

text: The slum lies outside the walls or at the edge.
A gate ward forms at each gate.
Docks lie along the water.
Farmland lies outside the built area.
source: Emilien et al., Procedural Generation of Villages on Arbitrary Terrains, The Visual Computer 28 (2012)

text: Building density falls from the centre outward.
source: Lynch, The Image of the City (1960); Watabou, Medieval Fantasy City Generator (2016)

text: Every plot has access to a street.
source: Emilien et al., Procedural Generation of Villages on Arbitrary Terrains, The Visual Computer 28 (2012)

text: A building faces its street and sits at the front setback; outbuildings go behind.
source: Alexander et al., A Pattern Language (1977) (pattern 105, South-facing outdoors; 140, Private terrace on the street)

text: A garden lies behind or beside its house, away from the street.
source: Alexander et al., A Pattern Language (1977) (pattern 173, Garden wall)

text: A square's centrepiece stands at its centre.
source: Lynch, The Image of the City (1960) (landmarks and nodes)

text: A temple closes the view at the end of a street.
source: Lynch, The Image of the City (1960)

text: The downtown with its towers is at the centre, where the avenues cross.
Buildings are tallest downtown and lower outward; suburbs are low.
Industry is at the edge, by water, rail or the highway, away from homes.
Shops and commercial strips line the main roads.
City hall and civic buildings are near the centre, on a plaza.
Every residential district has a park or playground within a short walk.
Schools sit inside residential neighbourhoods, not on main roads.
Large parking lots sit behind or beside big stores, not in front of downtown streets.
The station is downtown, on an avenue.
Streets have sidewalks on both sides, with lamps, trees and bins along them.
